newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia's end-Feb palm oil stocks 722,993 tonnes.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia's end-Feb palm oil stocks 722,993 tonnes.

text.p: Malaysia's palm oil stocks rose 3.81 percent to 722,993 tonnes at end-February from 696,487 at end-January and compared with 727,257 at end-Februry 1996, the Palm Oil Registration and Licensing Authority (PORLA) said on Saturday.

Stocks of crude palm oil were 400,864 tonnes, against 356,279 at end-January and 406,782 a year earlier. Processed palm oil stocks totalled 322,129 tonnes compared with 340,208 and 320,475 respectively, PORLA said.

Stocks of crude palm kernel oil were 40,077 tonnes at end-February against 47,421 at end-January and 31,723 at end-February 1996. Processed palm kernel oil stocks were 59,699 tonnes compared with 49,768 and 44,207 respectively.
